page.notes: Running head and the stain over the word "MAGNI" are partly illegible; the reading is uncertain. Several words are covered by a dark blot (Archelaum/Philippum line, "parum", "Bellane", "ferocie"); marked illegible or with [?]. The two stacked numerals at left (36|33 / 37|34) sit in the margin beside the §. 10 line and are recorded as a note; their exact reading is uncertain. A stray dot below the Herodis line is ignored. The catchword "plum" completes the hyphenated word "tem-plum" on the next page.
